content: Amɔnibɑn sunɔ wi bɑ mɔ̀ Nɑkɑsi u seewɑ u dɑ u Yɑbɛsi wɔri Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Mɑ Yɑbɛsiɡibu kpuro bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ sun ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuo, sɑ ko nun yoru diiyɑ.
Adɑmɑ Nɑkɑsi u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, ì n wurɑ n bɛɛn bɑɑwuren nɔm ɡeun nɔnu wɔwɑ, kpɑ bɛɛ Isirelibɑ kpuro i sekuru wɑ, sɑnɑm mɛyɑ kon kɑ bɛɛ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke.
Yɑbɛsin ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɛ̃ɛyɔ su wɑ su kɑ tɔmbu ɡɔri Isirelin tem kpuro sɔɔ. Sɑ̀ kun wɑ wi u koo sun fɑɑbɑ ko, sɑ ko bɛɛ tii yɔ̃suɑ.
Yerɑ ɡɔro be, bɑ dɑ Gibeɑɔ mi Sɔɔlu u wɑ̃ɑ, bɑ lɑbɑɑri ye ɡeruɑ. Ye tɔmbɑ nuɑ mɛ, mɑ be kpuro bɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ bɑ swĩ.
N deemɑ Sɔɔlu u wee ɡberun di kɑ win kɛtɛbɑ, mɑ u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n tɔn be deemɑ bɑ kɑ sumɔ mɛ. Mɑ bɑ nùn Yɑbɛsiɡibun ɡɑri yi sɑɑriɑ.
Ye Sɔɔlu u yi nuɑ, yerɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ mɑ win nukurɑ ɡbisɑ ɡem kɑ tiɑ.

Yerɑ u win kɛtɛbɑ yiru suɑ u ɡo u ye bɔtirɑ bɔtirɑ, mɑ u derɑ bɑ kɑ yen kpiri ni dɑ Isirelin tem kpuro sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ koo bɑɑwuren kɛtɛbɑ kuɑ wi u yinɑ u Sɔɔlu kɑ Sɑmuɛli swĩi bɑ̀ n tɑbu seewɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn bɛrum mu tɔn be mwɑ, yerɑ be kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ yɑrɑ nɡe tɔn turo.
Sɔɔlu u derɑ bɑ tɔn be ɡɑrɑ ɡɑrɑ Besɛkiɔ. Isirelibɑn ɡeerɑ kuɑwɑ tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300.000). Yudɑbɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ (30.000).
Mɑ bɑ Yɑbɛsiɡibun ɡɔro be sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i doo i bɛɛɡibu sɔ̃ i nɛɛ, siɑ sere sɔ̃ɔ u kɑ ye, bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Ye ɡɔro be, bɑ turɑ bɑ Yɑbɛsiɡii be sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛ, yerɑ ben nukurɑ dorɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Amɔnibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, siɑ sɑ ko bɛɛ tii yɔ̃suɑ i kɑ sun ko nɡe mɛ n bɛɛ wɛ̃re.
Sɔɔlu u win tɔmbu bɔnu kuɑ wuunu itɑ. Yen sisiru sɑɑ ye ɡoo ɡbiikɑɑ swĩ, u derɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Amɔnibɑn sɑnsɑni wɔri bɑ bu ɡo ɡo sere sɔ̃ɔ kɑ ye. Be bɑ tie bɑ yɑrinɛwɑ bɑ sebiri tiɑ tiɑ.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Sɑmuɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, berɑ̀ bɑ ǹ dɑɑ kĩ Sɔɔlu u ko bɛsɛn sunɔ. Be bɑ ɡeruɑ mɛ, ɑ de bu yɑrimɑ su bu ɡo.
Adɑmɑ Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ ɡoo ɡoomɔ ɡisɔ, domi ɡisɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u sun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i nɑ su dɑ Giliɡɑliɔ kpɑ su Sɔɔlun bɑndun dɑm sire.
Mɑ be kpuro bɑ dɑ mi, bɑ Sɔɔlun bɑndun dɑm sire Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Bɑ mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ. Mɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di kɑ nuku dobu.
